about: The speech gate: when a track's audio is sent to be transcribed. Shared by the bridge (pytest) and the web app (Vitest) so the two gates never drift. Frames are 100 ms at 16 kHz; q is quiet (every sample 20), l is loud (every sample 3000). input is runs of [level, frames]; events lists every frame that sends something (at is a frame index, or an inclusive [from, to] range, each frame sending `sent` frames); every other frame sends nothing. commit marks the end of an utterance, and keep says whether it had enough speech to transcribe.

cases.name: speech opens the gate with the 600 ms before it
the gate closes after 1.5 s of quiet
a short pause doesn't close it
local: an utterance ends after 0.7 s of quiet, and a cough is too short to keep
local: 0.4 s of speech is kept
local: only loud frames count as speech, and 0.3 s is enough
local: a long speech is cut every 15 s and goes on as a new utterance
local: after an utterance, quiet is buffered again for the next one
